record.name: GripaTrip: AI Travel Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Trip planning should feel simple, personal, and fully in your control. GripaTrip helps you plan your trip your way, not someone else’s. Discover destinations that match your vibe, build a personalized itinerary, manage your budget, organize travel documents, and handle your trip on the go — all in one AI travel planner.
GripaTrip is an all-in-one AI trip planner, travel organizer, itinerary builder, budget manager, and live trip dashboard designed to make travel planning easier from start to finish. Whether you are planning a weekend escape, family vacation, business trip, or international journey, GripaTrip gives you everything you need to create your own trip, your own memories, and your own travel style.
Discover destinations that match your vibe
Not sure where to go next? Use GripaTrip to explore destinations, discover places that fit your mood, interests, and travel style, and find ideas for your next escape. From curated travel inspiration to weekend getaway ideas, GripaTrip helps you choose the right destination before planning begins.
Plan your trip with AI
Once you choose a destination, GripaTrip helps you create a personalized trip plan in seconds. Generate an AI itinerarybased on your preferences, travel dates, interests, and budget. Build a smart day-by-day travel itinerary, then customize every activity, place, event, and timing exactly the way you want.
Create a budget-aware itinerary
Travel plans should fit your budget, not ignore it. GripaTrip helps you build a budget-friendly itinerary, manage your travel budget, and stay in control of spending before and during the trip.
Track expenses and split costs easily
Manage trip spending with built-in expense tracking, split expenses, and receipt scanning. Record costs, organize shared travel expenses, and keep your budget clear whether you are traveling solo, with friends, or with family.
Stay organized with checklists and reminders
Never miss an important travel detail. Create custom travel checklists, set reminders for tasks before departure and during the trip, and keep everything organized in one place — from packing and documents to trip-day actions.
Upload documents and extract important travel info
GripaTrip lets you upload travel documents and automatically extract useful information from flight and hotel bookings. Keep your key travel details ready for quick access without searching across emails and files.
Access visa information and travel essentials
Check visa information and important trip details while planning, so you can prepare with more confidence before you travel.
Use the live trip dashboard on the go
GripaTrip is not just for planning — it is built for executing your trip too. With the live trip dashboard, you can quickly access:
	•	flight bookings
	•	boarding passes
	•	flight status
	•	today’s activities
	•	tomorrow’s plan
	•	on-the-go expense management
	•	key trip details in one tap
Share and collaborate on trips
Plan better with others. Share your trip with friends and family, collaborate on ideas, build your itinerary together, and keep everyone aligned before and during the journey.
Why travelers use GripaTrip
	•	AI trip planner for personalized travel plans
	•	Destination discovery based on your vibe
	•	Weekend escape and travel inspiration features
	•	Smart itinerary and plan generation
	•	Budget-aware itinerary creation
	•	Expense tracker with split expenses and receipt scan
	•	Custom travel checklist and reminders
	•	Flight and hotel document upload with info extraction
	•	Visa information for easier planning
	•	Live trip dashboard for travel execution
	•	Shared trip planning with friends and family
Whether you are looking for a trip planner, travel planner, itinerary app, vacation planner, travel organizer, or AI travel assistant, GripaTrip helps you plan smarter, organize better, and travel with confidence.

WanderSolo is the AI travel planner made for solo travelers who want safe, budget-friendly itineraries without the headache of endless research. Whether it's your first solo trip or your fiftieth, WanderSolo builds trip plans that actually fit your life.

HOW IT WORKS

Tell us four things:
- Where you want to go
- Your total budget
- How many days, or specific dates
- Anything you really want to see or do

Our AI handles the rest, delivering a full day-by-day itinerary in seconds.

WHY SOLO TRAVELERS LOVE WANDERSOLO

Itineraries in Seconds
No more nights lost to research, conflicting blog posts, or thirty open browser tabs. Get a complete, personalized trip plan faster than it takes to brew your morning coffee.

Budget That Actually Sticks
Set your spending limit and get an itinerary that respects every dollar. No surprise costs, no overpriced tourist traps, no coming home to a wrecked credit card.

Built-In Safety Score
Every destination and recommendation includes a safety rating, so you can travel solo with confidence. Know which neighborhoods are welcoming, which spots are traveler-friendly, and where to feel at ease before you ever land.

Personalized to You
Want hidden coffee shops, art museums, hiking trails, or a great night out? Tell us, and watch your itinerary shape itself around what you actually care about.

PERFECT FOR

- Solo female travelers who prioritize safety
- Budget backpackers stretching every dollar
- Digital nomads planning quick getaways
- First-time international travelers
- Weekend wanderers and spontaneous adventurers

WHAT YOU GET

A complete day-by-day itinerary with safety scores, budget breakdowns, activity picks, and neighborhood suggestions, all built around your trip in seconds.

Travel solo. Travel safe. Travel smart.

Download WanderSolo and make your next trip the easiest one yet.

record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Wayfind is the travel planner that turns scattered ideas, bookings, and maps into one clear trip—from the first spark of a destination to the last day on the road.

Whether you’re squeezing in a long weekend or mapping a multi-country route, Wayfind keeps every day, every booking, and every place in a single timeline you can actually use—not a pile of tabs and screenshots.

PLAN WITH AI—OR BY HAND

Describe how you like to travel (pace, interests, budget vibe) and let AI draft full day-by-day plans with real places and practical context—then tweak everything: add restaurants, sights, and custom stops, drag to reorder, assign items to specific days, and see the whole journey at a glance. Prefer full control? Build the itinerary yourself with the same flexible tools.

IMPORT BOOKINGS AUTOMATICALLY

Forward confirmation emails—flights, hotels, cars, trains, activities—to your unique Wayfind inbox and watch the important details land in your trip. Less manual entry, fewer missed confirmations, and fewer “where did I save that PDF?” moments.

SEE YOUR TRIP ON A MAP

Every stop and booking with a location appears on an interactive map. Tap a pin for details, jump to that day in your plan, open directions when you’re ready to move, and understand how your days fit together geographically—not just as a list.

STAY ON BUDGET—AND ON TIME

Set budgets by category (food, stays, transport, and more) so planning stays honest before you fly. Smart reminders help you stay ahead of check-ins, departures, and the activities you care about—so the app works quietly in the background while you focus on the trip.

PLAN TOGETHER

Invite travel companions to view or help edit the same itinerary. Everyone sees the same map, timeline, and updates—so you’re not reconciling three different versions of “the plan.”

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

AI-assisted and manual day-by-day itinerary building
Email forwarding for automatic booking capture
Interactive map with your stops and bookings
Travel context between places (so days feel connected, not random)
Budget tracking by category
Collaboration with tripmates
Helpful notifications for key moments in your trip
Sign in with Apple or Google
Start your next trip in Wayfind—free to download. Upgrade when you’re ready for power features built for frequent travelers and longer adventures.

record.name: Tripy: AI Travel Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Tell Tripy where you want to go. Get a full day-by-day itinerary in about 20 seconds — with real places, accurate opening hours, and a route that actually makes sense.

Tripy turns a one-line request — "Istanbul for 4 days, food and architecture" — into a complete trip plan. Built for travelers who organize their own trips and want to spend the time traveling, not researching.

WHAT MAKES TRIPY DIFFERENT

• Real places, not hallucinations. Every spot comes from a verified database. No AI-invented restaurants, no museums that closed years ago.

• Personalized to your interests. Tripy ranks places against what you actually care about — not a generic "Top 10" list everyone else gets.

• Optimized routes. Each day is ordered to minimize walking and backtracking. You see the city, not the inside of taxis.

• Full details on every stop. Opening hours, prices, how long to spend, what to order, what to skip.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick a city, your dates, and a few interests (food, mountains, architecture, nightlife — your call).
2. Choose Auto for a ready plan in seconds, or Manual to build it day by day.
3. Edit anything: reorder stops, swap places, optimize the route with one tap.
4. Save your trip and open any stop in Apple Maps when you're on the ground.

GREAT FOR

• Weekend city breaks where you don't want to spend Friday night planning.
• Multi-day trips you'd otherwise piece together across review sites and screenshots.
• Travelers who've tried asking an AI chatbot and ended up at a restaurant that no longer exists.
• Anyone who'd rather arrive with a plan than wing it.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

Saved trips, places, and lists are stored on your device. No account required, no tracking, no ads. The only thing that leaves your phone is the trip request itself — and only when you ask Tripy to generate something new.

START PLANNING

Tap +, pick a city, tell Tripy what you like. Your itinerary is ready before your coffee's cold.

Questions or feedback? Email matveyvoronezh@gmail.com — we read every message.

record.name: Travel Bause
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Travel Bause is the travel planning and adventure app.

Every trip you take, saved where you can reach it. Challenges you walk, counted in steps, that end in a crest you wear. Bucket lists you build and share with anyone.

Free to join, with a free plan that is always there. Nothing you upload or plan is ever taken away.

YOUR TRIPS
Plan a trip with Copernicus, your concierge, and it stays on your shelf: the days, the places, the photographs, the line you wrote at dinner. Each trip says where it stands: upcoming, underway or completed. Ask Copernicus for the itinerary from the last time you were in a city and it brings it back.

CHALLENGES AND CRESTS
A challenge is a route through a place, curated by Travel Bause: Hyde Park to the Golden Lady in Chicago, Ancient Rome Without a Ticket, the Cosmopolitan in Las Vegas. Most are walks, and each tells you up front how far (about 9,500 steps for Hyde Park) with the route on a map. Verify each stop on location in the app to earn Bause Cred. Finish the challenge and you wear its crest. Bring friends along with one link and walk it as a crew.

BUCKET LISTS
Make a list of the places you mean to reach: the Seven Seas, every NFL stadium, the waterfalls of the world. Check a place off verified, from the place itself, or mark it Been There for the ones that came before. Share any list with a link. Friends can read it without an account, and members can copy it into their own. On a membership, Copernicus will build a list for you or add to one.

THE APP CONFIRMS YOU WERE THERE
Take a photograph with the camera in the app and Travel Bause checks the phone's own location against the place. When they match, the post wears a green field frame: I was there. Nobody can say that from a hotel lobby.

THE STERLING STANDARD
Every hotel and restaurant we cover is assessed against five weighted dimensions, scored in the open and signed by the correspondent who did the work. The ladder runs Pinnacle, Distinguished, Recommended, Acceptable. Our assessments can't be bought, and we publish the ones that disappointed too.

COPERNICUS, YOUR CONCIERGE
Copernicus carries every assessment we have published, knows your trips, and builds the next one out of everything the last one taught it. Ask about somewhere we have not covered yet and, on a membership, it will research the property for you and tell you plainly that is what it did.

THE ATLAS
The map is the menu. Search any hotel, restaurant or bar and read the assessment in full before you pack. A field assessment names the founder who walked in; a desk-researched card says so on its face.

THE VAULT
Passports, known-traveller numbers and loyalty accounts, stored once and masked to the last four at the database itself. Each is revealed only when you say so, and locks again after fifteen minutes.

YOUR STANDING
Members hold numbered seats and wear what they have done: cred earned in the field, crests carried home from the road, a member card with your number on it. No follower counts.

THE MAGAZINE
Long-form coverage by Maxwell Sterling and Tiberius Blackstone, disclosed AI correspondents. No assessment publishes until a human editor signs it off by name. The disclosure is not fine print. It is the point.

MEMBERSHIP
Travel Bause is free to join, and the atlas is free to read. Bause ($9.99/month) and Bause Pro ($19.99/month) open the full archive, Copernicus's research on properties we have not yet covered, and the editing suite. Each is a one-month auto-renewing subscription, charged to your Apple Account and renewing unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account subscription settings.

No advertising. No sponsored lists. No paid placement.
